# PLAN-777 modularity-audit 自测夹具配置（假想 workspace；见同目录 README.md）
schema = "module-boundaries/1"

[domains.members]
fixture-lang = "lang-core"
fixture-lang-sdk = "lang-core"
fixture-ui = "ui"
fixture-ui-kit = "ui"
fixture-test-util = "test"
fixture-app = "app"

[[rules.forbidden_declared]]
id = "lang-core-no-ui"
from_domains = ["lang-core"]
to_domains = ["ui"]
kinds = ["normal", "build"]

[[text_scan]]
id = "core_to_ui_fixture"
description = "fixture：语言 core 源码对 UI 模块的文本引用候选（非语义边）"
source_roots = ["crates/fixture-lang/src"]
patterns = ["\\bcrate::fixture_ui\\b", "\\bcrate::fixture_ui_kit\\b"]

[[assets]]
id = "fixture-assets"
root = "assets/fixture-assets"
owner = "ui"
exit_phase = "RX"
coverage_group = "assets"

[[ownership]]
id = "fixture-weld-sdk-entry"
kind = "weld"
path = "crates/fixture-lang/src/lib.rs"
owner = "ui"
exit_phase = "RX"
status = "active"
coverage_group = "weld"

# 覆盖组对账（777 r1 复审 F05）：缺组在 strict 判红
[ownership_coverage]
required = ["weld", "assets"]

[baseline]
# 只允许窄豁免：[[baseline.edge_notes]] 逐边 owner + 退出阶段。
# 任何目录级/前缀级豁免键（exempt_paths 等）在配置加载时即被拒绝（V-04d）。
cases.expected: nonzero exit and unchanged input bytes
